name: mili-ssm
description: mili-ssm's Claude Code plugins: agent-skills (specialist skills and agents) and opt-in mods.

plugins.name: agent-skills
plugins.description: Generic specialist skills and agents that complement Superpowers and Playwright.

plugins.name: plan-progress
plugins.description: Mod: compact progress of the active implementation plan, only while there is one: status line (all surfaces) plus a card above the prompt (terminal, desktop).

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Mod: how long the model worked until it needed you, per interaction cycle (your prompt to your next one): live status line, then one line with busy time, tokens per model (subagents included) and tools, skills and agents used, plus session totals; /usage-band for a summary.

plugins.name: tool-fold
plugins.description: Mod: tool calls, skills and agents in the chat fold into compact lines; a run of them into one group line with a Haiku summary. Running agents stay live (card, mission, current call, task progress) until they end. Agent notices shrink to one line.
